Sir,
In continuation to this office letter no. Pension-I/Instructions/Guidelines/2017/8351
dated 07.08.2017 under reference it is informed that Para 2 of the same circular be read as:

“It is clarified that Aadhaar linking as per clause 3(i) of the letter of 07.10.2016 cited 2"
above means that the employees’ Aadhaar number has been checked by the employer and
submitted to the EPFO either electronically or physically or alternatively that the employee has
submitted the same through common service centers as envisaged vide circular no

CAIU/011/(27)/2017/KYC/34320 dated 24.032017 and RI/CDAC/Aadhaar/2014/Vol-II/5498
dated 28.06.2017.

(This issues with the approval of CPFC)

Yo S faithfully,
